-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #120 / Scene #3 - Function Phindous_Senerep_TalkEvent3
function Phindous_Senerep_TalkEvent3()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("BGM003.ogg")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town001D.fld")
	MoveCamera(0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	RotCamera(0.00, 1.57, 100.00)

	CreateObject(0, 10002, 690.00, 744.00, 182, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(1, 1478, 681.00, 751.00, 54, 0, FALSE, 1, 1)
	CreateObject(2, 1479, 677.00, 759.00, 54, 0, FALSE, 1, 10)
	CreateObject(3, 1480, 672.00, 753.00, 54, 0, FALSE, 1, 19)
	CreateObject(4, 1481, 672.00, 744.00, 54, 0, FALSE, 1, 28)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayCameraNoWait("Phin_Senerep_Talk_04.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(13, 5)
	PlayMusic("BGM003.ogg")

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(Phindous_Senerep_TalkEvent3)
